standard_prerequisites.name: A finite type extension of the ring can be built whose completion is the quotient of the completion by a prescribed ideal that has only the maximal ideal as associated prime
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the finite type ring B with completion A-hat modulo J in the case of dimension one.

standard_prerequisites.name: The dimension formula for a flat local map of Noetherian local rings, comparing dimensions with the transcendence degrees of the residue field and of the fibre
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the inequality that contradicts the dimension count once a prime lying over the zero ideal is produced.

standard_prerequisites.name: Prime avoidance lets one choose an element of the maximal ideal avoiding finitely many prescribed primes
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the element f used in the induction step so that the quotient by f is again not formally catenary with the invariant decreased.

core_obligations: Reduce to the case where A is a domain: a minimal prime whose quotient of the completion is not equidimensional is divided out, keeping the failure of formal catenarity (proof lines 32330-32334).

Choose a minimal prime q of the completion with the value of the dimension of the completion modulo q minimal, get a positive value d smaller than the dimension of A, and argue by induction on d (proof lines 32334-32336).

Case d = 1: use that the localization at q is Artinian to find a power J of q annihilated there, so that the maximal ideal is the only associated prime of J modulo J squared and the finite type extension B with completion A-hat modulo J exists (proof lines 32337-32343).

Identify the completion of B with the adic completion at the maximal ideal, compute that the localization of B has dimension one, and produce a prime q' over the zero ideal; the dimension formula for a universally catenary ring would force a strict inequality with the transcendence degree, a contradiction (proof lines 32344-32364).

Case d greater than one: let Z be the union of the components other than the one cut out by q, list the positive dimensional components of the intersection, choose an element of the maximal ideal avoiding them by prime avoidance, and check that the quotient by that element is again not formally catenary with the invariant decreased, so the induction applies (proof lines 32365-32386).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a domain whose completion is not equidimensional and set up the induction on the minimal dimension of a component of the completion (proof lines 32330-32336).
Dimension one case: build a finite type extension with completion the quotient by a power of q (proof lines 32337-32347).
Contradict universal catenarity with the dimension formula applied to a prime lying over the zero ideal (proof lines 32348-32364).
Dimension greater than one: cut down by one equation chosen by prime avoidance so that the hypothesis and the invariant survive (proof lines 32365-32386).
difficulty_reason: statement 只有一句（非形式化的 Noetherian 局部环不是万有链环），证明却是一段真正的双向归纳：先把环约化到整环、把完备化中「维度最小的极小素理想处维数 d」当作归纳量；d=1 时要用「幂零理想使完备化成商」构造有限型扩张 B，再用维数公式与超越次数推出矛盾；d>1 时要用素理想回避挑一个元素把 d 降下去。承重演算（维数、超越次数、回避、归纳传递）都在 span 内做完；4 处引用里 1 处同章、3 处跨章，全部导航桩。
